content.short: Camelot Guardian is a tower-defense NFT blockchain game on Arbitrum.
content.description: Camelot Guardian is a tower defense game where players shield their kingdom from waves of foes using NFT characters. Rewards appear as in-game assets like Gold and Diamonds, which can be converted into the Camelot Utility Token (CMT) through a dedicated conversion mechanism. The game also features a governance token called CGT alongside its utility token, CMT. This blockchain-based dual-token economy lets players earn both tokens through gameplay and governance participation, adding a deeper layer of engagement to the medieval tower defense experience.
